The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of EMD, the FDR will be released in the favour of the bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Bidder has to upload scanned copy/ proof of the FDR along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date/ Bid Opening date 7. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Payment online through RTGS / internet banking in Beneficiary name UP MEDICAL SUPPLIES CORPORATION LIMITED Account No. 39366886265 IFSC Code SBIN0012732 Bank Name STATE BANK OF INDIA Branch address Arjunganj Lucknow . Bidder to indicate bid number and name of bidding entity in the transaction details field at the time of on- line transfer.
